page.layout: Two parallel columns of Latin and Hebrew grammatical entries, with the page number at top left and two Hebrew section letters at the head. Left column: continuation line, letter heading, then entries down to the foot. Right column: continuation line, entries, letter headings, and entries to the foot. No notes in the margins, no catchword, no signature.

page.notes: Hebrew letters at the head (left "ת ש", right "ת׳") are taken as dictionary letter guides and are doubtful. Many Hebrew forms are uncertain and not checked letter by letter, notably the forms תִּטֹּר, תִּטְשֵׁנִי, תִּיבֵשׁ, תִּינְעֶנּוּ, תִּיטִיב and the root of labores; they are copied as best seen, without [?] on each letter. The Latin "vel" and abbreviations are as printed. The right column's first line, "f. f. Rad. נָטַר.", continues the left column's last entry. The two-line ending "3. f." after "vel" is printed on its own line at the foot.
